articles.title: Trump expected to attend White House meeting with crypto CEOs, sources say
articles.snippet: Those involved in a meeting of CEOs from the worlds of crypto, prediction markets and AI anticipate President Donald Trump will take part in next week's gathering.

articles.title: Trump-backed World Liberty wins conditional bank charter from federal regulator
articles.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency said it granted "preliminary conditional approval" to World Liberty Trust Co. on Friday.

articles.title: Trump family's World Liberty Financial delay plans to sell Maldives resort token
articles.snippet: The token’s sale has been pushed back due to the Iran war disrupting travel in the region.

articles.title: Trump-Linked World Liberty Gets Conditional Bank Charter for USD1 Stablecoin
articles.snippet: The proposed World Liberty Trust Company would take over issuance of the USD1 stablecoin from BitGo.

articles.title: White House Lets Private Firms Hack Cybercriminals—At Their Own Legal Risk
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump signed a memorandum Tuesday that lets vetted U.S. companies carry out offensive cyber operations against foreign criminal networks. Here's what the program actually authorizes.
